t: The Hager Sollysta WMGS12 20AX grid control switch with a white finish offers robust electrical control for various installations. Its shallow modules clip easily from the front, simplifying both initial installation and future maintenance tasks. Featuring backed-out captive terminal screws, wiring is straightforward, accepting 2 x 4mm² cables. Frame design allows access to terminal screws even when modules are clipped in, and frames clip together to aid alignment for multi-gang setups, ensuring a professional finish flush with the wall.
b: Terminal Screw Can Be Accessed With Modules Clipped Into Frames
Frames Clip Together To Ease Alignment For 6 & 8 Gang Applications
